info.title: Sentry IO Universal API
info.description: Monitor Sentry organizations, projects, issues, events, teams, releases, replays, and Explore data from MindCloud workflows and Cirra.

get.description: Retrieves events for an issue in Sentry IO.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

get.description: Retrieves issues from a Sentry IO organization.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: organizationIdOrSlug
parameters.description: The Sentry organization ID or slug.

schema.description: The Sentry organization ID or slug.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional Sentry structured search query. Leave blank for Sentry's default unresolved issue query; pass an empty query value to request all results.

schema.description: Optional Sentry structured search query. Leave blank for Sentry's default unresolved issue query; pass an empty query value to request all results.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Optional Sentry project ID. Sentry also accepts -1 for all available projects.

schema.description: Optional Sentry project ID. Sentry also accepts -1 for all available projects.

parameters.name: statsPeriod
parameters.description: Optional time range such as 24h, 7d, or 14d for issue stats.

schema.description: Optional time range such as 24h, 7d, or 14d for issue stats.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Optional Sentry issue sort such as date, freq, inbox, new, recommended, trends, or user.

schema.description: Optional Sentry issue sort such as date, freq, inbox, new, recommended, trends, or user.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Optional Sentry pagination cursor from the Link header.

schema.description: Optional Sentry pagination cursor from the Link header.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

assignedTo.description: Actor ID or username of the user or team to assign to the issue.

isBookmarked.description: Whether the invoking user has bookmarked the issue.

isSubscribed.description: Whether the invoking user is subscribed to issue notifications.
